author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
I do not wish to recreationally build maps anymore, with myself moving onto a different project to build for. As such, as a gift, I'm giving away a package of the following maps, under these conditions:

- You may use these on any server you like, including but not limited to scrimmage servers, testing servers, and public-play servers. This grants you access to freely use maps that I authored by myself, however maps with other authors must be credited and not used for public play (only testing/scrimmage/goofing around purposes). Any maps where I am the sole creator are free for you to use. You must transfer over the XML, should you want to play it however. The physical copies are what I'm giving away. However, I and all subsequent authors must be credited in both the XML and spectator spawn if it applies. To use a map for public (like an OCN clone) that is on this list that has other authors, seek permission.
- If there are any authors on any of the maps I released that owns a majority of the map and I don't remember, please alert me. I tried to keep it as safe and accurate as possible!


These are the maps included:
- Arcade 
- Fatal Temple
 - Parkour: Debris
 - Quarry
- Core
 - Rendezvous 2k17
 - Rolexius
 - Scaffold
 - Volcano Remix
- Deathmatch
 - Dragonblaze Peaks
 - Castella: Nexus
- Destroy
 - CherrylandMC
 - Aardvark
 - Fort Aqua
 - Jungletree Bazooka
 - Maisosen
 - Palm Rust
-  Flag
 - Boolean Classic
- Frenzy
 - Elevated 1
 - Elevated 2
 - Knuckles and Broken Goggles
 - La Cove
 - Presta
 - Salzburg 1
 - Salzburg 2
 - Shadient
 - Simon
 - Spore
- Hill
 - Eternal Virus
 - Mudslide
 - Silent as Violent
 - Venezuelan Hacker
 - U-Bahn
- Wool
 - Cobweb Hills

Some I did not release as I didn't do enough author work to warrant a release as author liberties were not shared evenly, therefore it being qualified more as somebody else's property. An example of this is Palm Rust. 

If you have any questions, feel free to ask! The download link for these 32 maps is https://www.dropbox.com/s/6nzy3xyx19lyjh1/Vice%27s%20Map%20Repo.zip?dl=0

Have a good day!
